VTS Scoring Log

Planet Peptide

planetpeptide.com · Est. 2024 · Neos Bio LLC · Bradenton, FL · Scored August 2026

Planet Peptide operates a publicly accessible site (not login-gated), with the operating entity Neos Bio LLC DBA Planet Peptide and a physical address (1201 6th Ave W Ste. 100, Bradenton, FL 34205) clearly disclosed in the site footer. Third-party testing is claimed for all products, but no testing laboratory is named anywhere on the site. No public COA library exists; COAs are available on request. Batch traceability is inconsistent - some products carry identifiers, others do not. A 30-day money-back guarantee for unopened products is referenced. Community research has flagged AI-generated content associated with the founder's story and raised questions about the COA signatory; these signals are documented in the Community Signal section and do not directly affect the VTS dimension scores.

26 /100
Low
Public site with Neos Bio LLC entity and physical address disclosed. No COA library, no lab named, COAs on request only. Inconsistent batch traceability. Community signal flags noted separately.
Dimension Scores
DimensionMaxNotesScore
Third-Party Testing Practice 30 Third-party testing is claimed on the site as "batch-specific analysis for every order" through "certified laboratories." No testing laboratory is named, no accreditation is cited, and no lab credentials are publicly accessible. The absence of a named lab means the testing claim cannot be independently evaluated. Minimal credit for the stated practice with no verifiable supporting documentation. 7/30
Batch Traceability & Verification 20 Batch traceability is inconsistent: some products carry batch identifiers, others do not per third-party review documentation. No searchable batch-to-COA linkage exists publicly. A request-based COA system cannot substitute for verifiable lot-level traceability accessible before purchase. 7/20
COA Accessibility 15 No COA library, no COAs on product pages. COAs are available on request from customer support, per community review sources. Request-only COA access scores equivalently to email-on-request under VTS methodology - minimal credit for the stated availability without any public documentation. 3/15
COA Completeness 15 No publicly accessible COA to review. Site language references "batch-specific analysis" without specifying HPLC, MS, or other methodologies. Testing scope cannot be evaluated. Minimal credit for the general testing claim. 3/15
Testing Recency 10 No COA dates publicly accessible for verification. Est. 2024, so all production would be recent by definition. Credit for a young operation with a stated commitment to per-batch testing, offset by the absence of any verifiable dated documentation. 2/10
Policy Transparency 5 Operating entity Neos Bio LLC DBA Planet Peptide prominently disclosed in site footer. Physical address (1201 6th Ave W Ste. 100, Bradenton, FL 34205) published. Shipping and return policy linked from the footer. 30-day money-back guarantee for unopened products documented. Social media accounts (Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Twitter) linked and active. No individual founders or team members named despite extensive brand narrative referencing a personal founding story. 2/5
Operational Track Record 5 Est. 2024, approximately 2 years of operation. Entity Neos Bio LLC publicly disclosed and verifiable. Physical address in Bradenton, FL published. Social media presence active across multiple platforms. Credit for the entity disclosure and physical address; recent founding limits the track record score. 2/5
Total 26/100
Community Signal
Independent Test Results
No community-commissioned independent test results identified in public forums as of August 2026. COA availability for this vendor is described as variable in tracking platforms - some batches appear traceable, others not. This field will be updated as independently sourced results are published.
Community Signal Flags
Two flags identified in community research: (1) AI-generated content has been identified in materials associated with the founder's personal narrative on the site. (2) Questions have been raised in forums about the identity or credentials of the COA signatory. PeptideClear cannot independently verify either flag from publicly accessible documentation. These are documented as community signals, not as scored findings. A researcher who considers these signals material should weigh them independently alongside the VTS score.
Scoring Notes
Entity disclosure is the clearest positive signal
Neos Bio LLC DBA Planet Peptide, with a physical address in Bradenton, FL, is a more transparent corporate identity than fully anonymous operators. The address is verifiable. The entity name is searchable in state business registries. For a young operation without a COA library or named lab, this is the primary transparency anchor.
What would move this score
A publicly accessible COA library with named lab and lot-specific documents would materially improve the Third-Party Testing Practice, COA Accessibility, and Batch Traceability scores. Naming the testing laboratory and providing verifiable credentials is the single highest-leverage transparency action available to this vendor within VTS methodology.
